input_usuario: Calcule o Índice de Saúde (IES-C) do município em 2024.
query_referencia: WITH desp AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS d FROM saude_saude WHERE ano_referencia = 2024), rec AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS r FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND (dsc_especie ILIKE '%Imposto%' OR dsc_origem ILIKE '%Transfer%')) SELECT (desp.d / NULLIF(rec.r, 0)) * 100 AS ies_c FROM desp, rec;
query_gerada: WITH cte_despesa_saude AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_liquidado AS DECIMAL)) AS total_despesa_saude FROM saude_saude WHERE ano_referencia = 2024), cte_receita_impostos_transferencias AS (SELECT SUM(CAST(vlr_realizadoateperiodo AS DECIMAL)) AS total_receita FROM receita_receita WHERE ano_referencia = 2024 AND (dsc_especie ILIKE '%Imposto%' OR dsc_origem ILIKE '%Transfer%')) SELECT (cte_despesa_saude.total_despesa_saude / NULLIF(cte_receita_impostos_transferencias.total_receita, 0)) * 100 AS indice_saude FROM cte_despesa_saude, cte_receita_impostos_transferencias;
